properties.description: Corridor defined by rupture, not an official region: an octagon following the Himalayan arc between about 80 and 89 E; the southern edge runs just south of the Main Frontal Thrust from about 28.2 N in the west to 26.5 N in the east, the northern edge from about 30.5 N in the west to 28.4 N in the east. Includes the 2015 Gorkha sequence and the 2026-08-26 landslide-type entry us7000tbwb.
